description: Source code for a Linux memory threshold notifier in Kubernetes, handling memory eviction thresholds and cgroup notifications.

classes.name: linuxMemoryThresholdNotifier
classes.description: Implements threshold notification for Linux memory eviction based on cgroup memory usage.

methods.name: UpdateThreshold
methods.description: Updates the memory threshold notifier with current memory stats and configures cgroup notifier accordingly.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the notifier, listening for memory threshold crossing events.

methods.name: Description
methods.description: Returns a string description of the current memory eviction threshold type.
